description: This file defines a Catalyst view class for creating emails using TT templates and Email::Stuffer. It includes a process method that prepares email content and sends it.

classes.name: Coocook::View::Email
classes.description: A Catalyst view class for generating and sending emails using templates.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Prepares email content based on the stash and sends the email using Email::Stuffer.
